summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, announcing the acquisition of 26,582,275 common shares of Orla Mining Ltd. via conversion of US$150M principal amount of convertible notes at C$7.90/share. Post-conversion, Fairfax holds 58,399,504 common shares and 17,544,302 warrants (C$11.50 strike), representing 15.7% non-diluted and 19.5% partially-diluted ownership. The filing is an early-warning report under Canadian securities law; no tender offer, going-private transaction, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine ownership disclosure, not a special-situation event. What to watch: further stake accumulation or a potential takeover bid.
